description: The marble front of the Basílica de Nossa Senhora de Nazaré at Belém, with its rose window, statue of the Virgin and gold-mosaic inscriptions
verification_note: The marble west front: rose window with the standing Virgin in front of it, flanking arched windows, and two gold-mosaic bands reading DEIPARÆ VIRGINI A NAZARETH and SALVE REGINA MATER MISERICORDIÆ above the portico columns. Honest limit — the towers and the full elevation are outside the frame; Commons has no good wide shot of this basilica.
